title: Services
subtitle: What customers can be helped with. Each service decides which queue a conversation goes to, what response times are measured, and whether AI may answer.
selectPrompt: Select a service to view or edit it.

create.name: New service name
create.failed: Could not create that service. The name may already be in use.

empty.title: No services yet
empty.description: Add one to start routing conversations by what the customer needs.

field.name: Name
field.queueHelp: Where conversations for this service wait to be answered.
field.aiEnabled: AI may answer conversations in this service
field.changeNoteHelp: Saved alongside the change, so this edit can be explained later.
field.aiPickupDelayHelp: How long AI waits before taking a conversation, so an agent can take it first. 0 means AI answers immediately.
field.aiConfidenceHelp: Below this, AI hands the conversation to a human instead of answering. Between 0 and 1.

editor.versionCreated: Saved as version {{version}}. Conversations already in progress keep the settings they started with.
editor.slaHelp: Leave blank for anything you do not want measured. Blank is not the same as 0 — 0 means the target is missed the moment the clock starts.
editor.historyHelp: Earlier settings are kept because conversations are still running on them.

archive.title: Archive this service?
archive.description: It will no longer appear in the directory and no new conversations will be routed to it. Conversations already running keep working, and can still say which service they belong to.
